ns2:section.sectionText: The seminar focuses on the fundamentals of applied data science and special topics that support research in the area. Topics include the use of Python and R in data science, git-based workflows, using Pytorch, performance profiling, and more general topics such as writing scientific papers in LaTeX. High-level research talks in the area will also be included.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
